analysis.summary_en: Paseo is an open source agentic development environment for desktop, mobile, web, and CLI.
highlights: Cross-device: iOS, Android, desktop, web, and CLI.
Built-in orchestration: Agents in Paseo can create worktrees, launch other agents, and talk to them, across providers.
Privacy-first: Paseo doesn't have any telemetry, tracking, or forced log-ins.
Parallel agents: Run many agents at once, each in its own worktree.
analysis.summary_zh_native: 在你自己的机器上并行运行 agents。无论在手机上还是桌前，都能推进交付。
highlights_zh: 跨设备： 支持 iOS、Android、桌面端、Web 和 CLI。
多提供商： 通过同一个界面使用 Claude Code、Codex、Copilot、OpenCode 和 Pi。
packages/cli：用于 daemon 和 agent 工作流的 paseo CLI
/paseo-handoff — 在 agents 之间交接工作。
